card.name: Casual openers and digits inside codes
card.fires_on: Casual interjections like Ok, Okay, Hey, Ooo starting a clause in informal web text, and a single digit or letter inside a number or code such as a phone number, postcode or IP address.

modes.label: Casual interjections
modes.description: Informal opener such as Ok, Okay or Hey starting a new sentence or quote in chatty text.

modes.description: A digit in the middle of a phone number, postcode, model number or IP address.
